  PROBLEM: The pass-2 shadow `large_diff` check uses `PASS2_DIFF_LOC`, which is computed from `LAST_RUN_DIFF_FILE` (the previous autofix diff) and not the PR diff, so `diff_loc` is 0 on a first review.

Severity disagreement: MAJOR from most reviewers, NIT from openai_gpt-6-luna; the highest is used, and MAJOR is mapped to high.

  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]

  WHY: A `diff_loc=0` result looks the same as a real zero-line diff, so the shadow metric is unreliable.

  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The new pass-2 shadow tests are pytest-style and are not called from `main()`. CI runs the file as `python3 tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py` (ci.yml:1111, mark-stable.yml:498, test-and-mark-stable.yml:4962), so only `main()` executes.
  WHY: The shadow behaviour, including `test_reviewer_pass2_still_launches_when_shadow_would_skip`, is never run in CI or the release gates. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from most reviewers, NIT from openai_gpt-6-luna; the highest is used, and MAJOR is mapped to high.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:5706-5729 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The shadow decision does not verify that pass 1 produced a schema-valid consensus ledger (`PASS1_LEDGER_FILE`) before logging `would_skip=true`.
  WHY: A malformed consensus with successful reviewer statuses can be logged as eligible to skip pass 2.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:5705 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The default always-full regex omits migration paths such as `db/migrations/`. The workflow default at `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:187` omits them too.
  WHY: A migration-only change is logged as `would_skip=true reason=eligible`, against the recommendation to keep two passes for migrations. The anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 reviewer dropped this as a follow-up (NIT, confidence 3), not a defect.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:67-83 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The auth regex in `_memory_stderr_category` is case-sensitive, so `403 forbidden` or `http 403 forbidden` falls into `other`.
  WHY: The telemetry category is wrong. minimax_minimax-m3 notes the case-sensitive shape is intentional, to avoid traceback frames like `line 403, in main`, and raised it as a hardening suggestion only.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:5680 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The shadow logging subshell redirects stderr to /dev/null, which swallows the `::warning::` from `reviewer_pass2_shadow_switch_state`.
  WHY: An invalid `REVIEWER_PASS2_SHADOW_ENABLED` value gives no visible warning, so it is hard to debug why shadow logging is off.

  WHY: Large PRs that touch no always-full path log `would_skip=true reason=eligible diff_loc=0`, so the shadow data overstates skip eligibility. `RAW_REVIEWER_PR_DIFF_FILE` is available but unused.
